description: For SELF-STORAGE OPERATORS checking their OWN pricing. Give your advertised monthly rate and a market; returns whether you're below / above / aligned with the local median per unit size, the %-distance, the annualised $ per unit you're leaving on the table (or charging over), and your rank vs nearby competitors. Omit size_bracket to sweep all unit sizes at once. Use for 'am I underpriced / overpriced / leaving money on the table / can I raise my rates'. Advertised public rates only — not occupancy or RevPAM. A market needs 3 competitor facilities and 3 observations; below that the status is insufficient_data. Omit my_monthly_price_aud if the user has not stated a price. Never invent one. Without a price the answer is the market median per unit size with verdict=null and a next_step. Pass provider or facility (the operator's own brand) so their own units are excluded from the competitor set. Rows below the implausibly-cheap floor are excluded from the rows and the market population. A row is below it when its advertised rate is under $5, or when its ongoing rate (the advertised rate if none is known) is under $7 per square metre of unit area, capped at the per-size floor (locker $20, small $20, medium $30, large $50, extra_large $80, garage_plus $50, vehicle $30). A row with no recorded area is held to the per-size floor. Rows with no recorded size and only a category name (large warehouse, office, other, small warehouse, warehouse) are left out too: their prices are unreliable.

facility.description: Your facility name, if focusing the comparison.

limit.description: Max rows to return. Anonymous callers are capped at 25-50 depending on the tool; a valid API key lifts the ceiling to 500. Values above your ceiling are clamped, not rejected.

my_monthly_price_aud.description: The operator's own advertised monthly price (AUD) to benchmark, greater than 0. Optional: omit it when the user has not stated a price.

my_ongoing_price_aud.description: Known post-promotion ongoing monthly rate (AUD), if publicly disclosed.

my_price_is_promotional.description: True when my_monthly_price_aud is an introductory/promotional rate. When omitted the price is treated as ongoing and the answer says assumed_ongoing=true.

provider.description: Provider slug to exclude/identify your own brand.

size_bracket.description: Unit size to benchmark. Omit to benchmark all sizes at once.

suburb.description: Australian suburb name, e.g. 'Chatswood'. A trailing state or postcode is peeled ('Sydney 2000'). Capital cities (Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, Canberra, Hobart, Darwin, Gold Coast) resolve to a city-wide radius scope. On price_distribution, an otherwise-empty exact Australian locality can resolve from the packaged ABS SAL snapshot even when StoragePrices has no prices there. Every answer states how the place resolved in `place`. `place.match_type` says how the name matched (exact, token or prefix, ...); when `place.ambiguous` is true the name also matches the places in `place.other_candidates` — confirm with the user or pass state.

name: operator_benchmark
